content: Tonic gRPC streaming pitfalls: HTTP/2 flow control via WINDOW_UPDATE frames handles transport-level backpressure. Application-level backpressure requires mpsc channels to avoid deadlocks. Broadcast channels drop old messages when receivers lag. Bidirectional streaming needs careful async management to avoid blocking the runtime. Configure SETTINGS_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE for stream-level flow control. Sending too fast without receiver keeping up overflows buffers.
